## S3 operations an implementation needs

| Operation | Notes |
|---|---|
| PutObject | Always with Content-MD5 (server-verified). Opportunistic If-None-Match: * on the first-publisher meta PUT (§2.9); correctness never depends on it. |
| HeadObject | Verification after upload (size, single-part ETag == MD5); strongly consistent on all supported backends. |
| GetObject | Ranged GETs for resumable hydration (§3.5) and read-back verification. |
| DeleteObject | Only by GC/compaction acting on a durable protocol record, never on absence (§2.1 principle 3). |
| CopyObject | Server-side copy for moves (§2.7). |
| ListObjectsV2 | Paging journal/manifest prefixes and additive-only reconciliation; never a source of absence. |
| CreateMultipartUpload / UploadPart / CompleteMultipartUpload / AbortMultipartUpload / ListMultipartUploads / ListParts | Objects ≥ SINGLE_PUT_MAX_BYTES; every UploadPart carries Content-MD5; parts may be signed UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD. |
